title: The Political Crisis in Puerto Rico

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访几位在商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 NYTimes.com 上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Babarro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: Hundreds of leaked text messages revealed the governor of Puerto Rico mocking his own citizens.
sentences.zh: 数百条泄露的短信显示，波多黎各总督在嘲笑自己的国民。

sentences.en: For Puerto Ricans, it was the last straw.
sentences.zh: 对于波多黎各人来说，这是压死骆驼的最后一根稻草。

sentences.en: It's Friday, July 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月19日，星期五。

sentences.en: Hi, Patty.
sentences.zh: 你好，帕蒂。

sentences.en: Hello, Michael Babarro.
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: Hello, hello.
sentences.zh: 你好，你好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I've been better.
sentences.zh: 我最近不太好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: I'm okay.
sentences.zh: 我还行。

sentences.en: Why have you been better?
sentences.zh: 为什么说你最近不太好？

sentences.en: What's the matter?
sentences.zh: 出什么事了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, I'm just tired.
sentences.zh: 哦，我只是太累了。

sentences.en: It's been really long nights, but that's okay.
sentences.zh: 最近熬了好几个通宵，不过没关系。

sentences.en: You've been staying up late covering the protests.
sentences.zh: 你一直在熬夜报道抗议活动。

sentences.en: Yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 是的，先生。

sentences.en: There's a meme in Puerto Rico of people saying, okay, I'm going to bed, and a friend telling them, like, but what if the governor resigns?
sentences.zh: 波多黎各现在有个梗，人们说，好吧，我要去睡觉了，然后朋友会告诉他们，万一总督辞职了怎么办？

sentences.en: And then, like, the person lying in bed with their eyes wide open, like, they don't want to miss that moment, and so...
sentences.zh: 然后那个人就躺在床上瞪大眼睛，因为他们不想错过那一刻，所以……

sentences.en: Right, right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: Like, the one moment you doze off is the moment it all happens.
sentences.zh: 就像你唯一一次打盹的时候，偏偏就是事情发生的时候。

sentences.en: That's what we live in fear of.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们担心的事。

sentences.en: I reached Patti Mazze, a national correspondent for The Times, in San Juan.
sentences.zh: 我在圣胡安联系到了《纽约时报》的全国记者帕蒂·马泽。

sentences.en: Patti, for most listeners, I suspect the story of Puerto Rico sort of hits the pause button in October of 2017.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，对于大多数听众来说，我怀疑关于波多黎各的故事在2017年10月就按下了暂停键。

sentences.en: Hurricane Maria hits, the island is thrown into darkness and into chaos, and President Trump's response is seen by many as insensitive and insufficient.
sentences.zh: 飓风“玛丽亚”来袭，岛上陷入黑暗和混乱，而特朗普总统的反应被许多人认为冷漠且不足。

sentences.en: Yes, but the story came back in April of this year.
sentences.zh: 是的，但这个故事在今年4月又重新出现了。

sentences.en: When members of Congress were considering a disaster aid bill.
sentences.zh: 当时国会议员们正在审议一项灾难援助法案。

sentences.en: Nature's forces have battered the United States in the past half year.
sentences.zh: 大自然的力量在过去半年里重创了美国。

sentences.en: Storm winds, floodwaters, and deadly wildfire.
sentences.zh: 风暴、洪水和致命的野火。

sentences.en: To those natural disasters, now add a man-made one.
sentences.zh: 在这些自然灾害之上，现在又增加了一场人为的灾难。

sentences.en: Not just for Puerto Rico, but for a bunch of states on the mainland that had suffered various natural disasters.
sentences.zh: 不仅是对波多黎各，还有美国本土遭受各种自然灾害的一系列州。

sentences.en: A dispute between President Trump and Democrats over hurricane relief for Puerto Rico is threatening disaster relief funding for California's wildfire victiMs.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统与民主党人之间关于波多黎各飓风救灾款的争端，正威胁到加州野火受灾者的救灾资金。

sentences.en: The president wanted to hold up the bill just because he did not want to send money to Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 总统想扣住这项法案，仅仅是因为他不想给波多黎各送钱。

sentences.en: So these were billions of dollars that would have gone to Florida, Texas, states in the Midwest that were suddenly at this impasse
sentences.zh: 所以，原本应该拨给佛罗里达州、德克萨斯州和中西部各州的数十亿美元，突然陷入了僵局，

sentences.en: because the president said, I'm not sending more to Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 因为总统说，我不会再给波多黎各送钱了。

sentences.en: President Trump accused Puerto Rico's leaders of misspending money they had already received.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统指责波多黎各领导人滥用了他们已经收到的资金。

sentences.en: He said the government can't do anything right, that the place is a mess, and nothing works there.
sentences.zh: 他说政府什么都做不好，那个地方一团糟，什么都行不通。

sentences.en: Here's part of the tweet.
sentences.zh: 这是那条推文的一部分。

sentences.en: The Pauls are grossly incompetent, spend the money foolishly or corruptly, and only take from the USA.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各人极其无能，挥霍钱财或贪污腐败，只会从美国索取。

sentences.en: And therefore he did not trust Puerto Rican leaders to manage new funds well.
sentences.zh: 因此，他不信任波多黎各领导人能管理好新的资金。

sentences.en: The best thing that ever happened to Puerto Rico, the tweet says, is President Donald J.
sentences.zh: 推文说，波多黎各发生过的最好的事情，就是唐纳德·J·特朗普总统。

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: And what's the response in Puerto Rico this time?
sentences.zh: 那么这次波多黎各的反应是什么？

sentences.en: So Puerto Ricans still don't like being called out by the president.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各人仍然不喜欢被总统点名批评。

sentences.en: They find that offensive.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这很冒犯人。

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean that some of them at least don't agree with some of the substance of his criticism,
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着他们中至少有些人不同意他批评的部分实质内容，

sentences.en: which is that the leaders on the island haven't always been very good fiscal stewards of public funds.
sentences.zh: 那就是岛上的领导人并不总是公共资金的良好财政管家。

sentences.en: Puerto Rico has suffered financial troubles for years and has had corruption scandals for decades.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各多年来一直遭受财政困境，几十年来一直有腐败丑闻。

sentences.en: And so people on the island were wary that once again, some of this might come up with billions of dollars in recovery aid flowing into the island.
sentences.zh: 所以岛上的人们担心，随着数十亿美元的恢复援助涌入岛内，这种情况可能会再次发生。

sentences.en: So Puerto Ricans don't entirely disagree with the president, that perhaps the island can't be trusted with the money.
sentences.zh: 所以波多黎各人并不完全不同意总统的看法，即也许这个岛不能被信任去管理这些钱。

sentences.en: No, and that's what made some of their response nuanced, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是为什么他们的一些反应很微妙，对吧？

sentences.en: You can be mad that the president, the only time he talks about you is to say bad things and still think he's got a point in that our leaders haven't always done well by us.
sentences.zh: 你可以因为总统唯一一次谈论你就是说坏话而感到愤怒，但同时仍然认为他说得有道理，即我们的领导人并不总是为我们着想。

sentences.en: I mean, in fact, Puerto Rico is effectively bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，事实上，波多黎各实际上已经破产了。

sentences.en: They're in a 12-year recession and they have a debt crisis.
sentences.zh: 他们处于长达12年的经济衰退中，并且面临债务危机。

sentences.en: Their leaders borrowed until they couldn't anymore and the island ran out of money.
sentences.zh: 他们的领导人借钱直到无法再借，岛上的钱也花光了。

sentences.en: So, Patty, what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么，帕蒂，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Desafortunadamente se han expandido a funcionarios que han tratado de extorsionarme.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，他们已经扩展到试图勒索我的官员身上。

sentences.en: Ya me lo menciono.
sentences.zh: 他已经向我提到了。

sentences.en: So three weeks ago, Puerto Rico's treasury secretary says in an explosive radio interview that he has gone to federal authorities to report this institutional mafia, he calls it,
sentences.zh: 三周前，波多黎各财政部长在一次爆炸性的电台采访中说，他已经向联邦当局举报了政府内部他所称的这种“体制化黑手党”，

sentences.en: within the government that is trying to extort him.
sentences.zh: 这些人正试图勒索他。

sentences.en: In a matter of hours, the governor asks the treasury secretary for his resignation,
sentences.zh: 几个小时内，总督就要求财政部长辞职，

sentences.en: saying he can't trust him because the secretary didn't go to the governor to tell him what he had found.
sentences.zh: 说他不信任他，因为部长没有先去找总督告诉他所发现的情况。

sentences.en: He went straight to the feds.
sentences.zh: 他直接去找了联邦政府。

sentences.en: El gobernador de Puerto Rico, Ricardo Rosselló, despidió ya su secretario de Hacienda, Raúl Maldonado, luego de que este denunciara corrupción en su propia agencia.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各总督里卡多·罗塞略在财政部长劳尔·马尔多纳多举报其部门内部腐败后，将其解雇。

sentences.en: Rosselló también destituyó a Maldonado...
sentences.zh: 罗塞略还罢免了马尔多纳多……

sentences.en: He's firing the treasury secretary for reporting an alleged extortion attempt to the United States government.
sentences.zh: 他因为财政部长向美国政府举报了一起涉嫌勒索的企图而将其解雇。

sentences.en: As you can imagine, that doesn't sit well with some of the governor's critics and also with some of the secretary's family members.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，这让总督的一些批评者以及部长的一些家人感到不满。

sentences.en: El hijo del exsecretario de Hacienda, Raúl Maldonado, hijo, hizo fuertes expresiones sobre el gobernador Ricardo Rosselló.
sentences.zh: 前财政部长劳尔·马尔多纳多之子对总督里卡多·罗塞略发表了强硬言论。

sentences.en: His son takes to social media to criticize the governor, and then the son gets investigated by police.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子在社交媒体上批评总督，随后该儿子遭到了警方调查。

sentences.en: And this starts turning into a real drama.
sentences.zh: 这开始演变成一场真正的闹剧。

sentences.en: Six people, including two former Puerto Rican officials, were arrested for allegedly diverting millions in federal funds
sentences.zh: 昨天，包括两名前波多黎各官员在内的六人因涉嫌将数百万美元的联邦资金转移给不合格且有政治背景的承包商而被捕。

sentences.en: to unqualified, politically connected contractors yesterday.
sentences.zh: 在这一切之中，上周，美国驻波多黎各检察官办公室宣布了六起引人注目的逮捕行动，其中包括前教育部长和该岛健康保险管理局的前执行董事。

sentences.en: In the middle of all this, last week, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 涉嫌的诈骗涉及自2017年以来分配的1550万美元联邦资金。

sentences.en: Attorney's Office in Puerto Rico announces six high-profile arrests, including of the former education secretary and of the former executive director
sentences.zh: 联邦政府称他们一直在欺诈联邦政府。

sentences.en: of the island's Health Insurance Administration Agency.
sentences.zh: 这就是真正令人失望的地方。

sentences.en: The alleged scam involves $15.5 million in federal funding allocated since 2017.
sentences.zh: 朱莉娅·凯勒赫，她曾令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: The feds say they were defrauding the federal government.
sentences.zh: 她很有干劲。

sentences.en: Here's what is really so disappointing.
sentences.zh: 她看起来像是一个能做些好事的人。

sentences.en: Julia Kelleher, she was impressive.
sentences.zh: 如果这是真的，对于一个急需帮助的岛屿来说，看到她倒台简直是一记响亮的耳光。

sentences.en: She was driven.
sentences.zh: 我当时也在想，你知道，波多黎各（PR）不需要任何负面的公关（PR），你知道的。

sentences.en: She seemed like someone who could do some good things.
sentences.zh: 最糟糕的是，总督当时正在欧洲度假。

sentences.en: It's such a slap in the face for an island that needs so much to see her go down, if this is true.
sentences.zh: 他取消了假期，把妻子和孩子留在地中海的一艘游轮上。

sentences.en: And what I was thinking, too, is that, you know, Puerto Rico, PR, does not need any bad PR, you know.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And to top it all off, the governor is on vacation in Europe.
sentences.zh: 然后尽快飞回岛上。

sentences.en: He calls off his vacation, leaves his wife and children on a cruise ship in the Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 就在他飞回来的路上，又出了新状况。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 有人泄露了总督和他11名最亲密助手之间在即时通讯软件 Telegram 上的群聊片段。

sentences.en: And flies back to get back to the island as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 在这次泄密中，包含了一些关于他们政治对手的冒犯性和亵渎性的评论。

sentences.en: And then while he's flying back, there's a new wrinkle.
sentences.zh: 总督发布了一张纽约市议会前议长梅丽莎·马克·维维里托推文的截图，她原本来自波多黎各，

sentences.en: Someone leaks bits and pieces of a group chat on the messaging app Telegram between the governor and 11 of his closest aides.
sentences.zh: 她在推文中批评了民主党全国委员会主席汤姆·佩雷斯。

sentences.en: And in this leak are offensive and profane comments that they make about some of their political opponents.
sentences.zh: 而总督的回应是：“nuestra gente debe salir a defender a Tom y caerle encima de esta puta.”

sentences.en: There is a snapshot that the governor posts of a tweet by the former speaker of the New York City Council, Melissa Mark Viverito, who was originally from Puerto Rico,
sentences.zh: 翻译成英文就是：我们的人需要出去捍卫汤姆，并攻击这个婊子。

sentences.en: where she's criticizing Tom Perez, the president of the Democratic National Committee.
sentences.zh: 那么，首先，下午好。

sentences.en: And the governor's response is, nuestra gente debe salir a defender a Tom y caerle encima de esta puta.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家来到这里。

sentences.en: Which, in English, means our people need to go out and defend Tom and go after this whore.
sentences.zh: 所以当总督降落在圣胡安时。

sentences.en: So, well, first of all, good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 呃，简短地说，我想来见见媒体。

sentences.en: Thank you all for being here.
sentences.zh: 整个媒体团已经集合完毕，准备发起猛攻。

sentences.en: So by the time the governor lands in San Juan.
sentences.zh: 你采取什么策略来维持政府运作和经济，让经济继续发展？

sentences.en: Uh, briefly, I wanted to come to the press.
sentences.zh: 嗯，好问题。

sentences.en: The entire press corps has assembled and is ready to pounce.
sentences.zh: 有人呼吁你辞去政治职务。

sentences.en: What strategy are you using to continue the operations of government and the economy, for the economy to continue?
sentences.zh: 你对这个呼吁有什么决定或回答吗？

sentences.en: So, good question.
sentences.zh: 我将继续履行我所有的民选职务。

sentences.en: There's been some calls for your resignation from your political positions.
sentences.zh: 你是这个密谋抹黑你不喜欢的人的聊天室的领导者。

sentences.en: Do you have a decision or an answer to that call?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要那样做？

sentences.en: So, I'm moving forward with all of my elected positions.
sentences.zh: 嗯，再说一次，我已经提到过，我，你知道，我对我的所作所为并不感到自豪。

sentences.en: You were the leader of this chat room that conspired to discredit people you didn't like.
sentences.zh: 那些仅仅是评论，但却是伤人的评论。

sentences.en: Why would you do that?
sentences.zh: 所以我为我的所作所为道歉。

sentences.en: Well, again, I've already mentioned I am, you know, I am not proud of what I did.
sentences.zh: 那么这个解释效果如何？

sentences.en: Those were merely comments, but they were hurtful comments.
sentences.zh: 效果并不怎么好。

sentences.en: So, I apologize for what I've done.
sentences.zh: 在聊天中被侮辱的人说，这是他们领导人不可接受的行为。

sentences.en: And how does that explanation go over?
sentences.zh: 而看到这些片段流出的波多黎各普通民众，只是在等待下一个爆料。

sentences.en: Not particularly well.
sentences.zh: 并不是说还有另一个片段流出。

sentences.en: The people who were insulted in the chat say that this is unacceptable behavior by their leaders.
sentences.zh: 自本周末调查中心泄露并发布了近900页的私人群聊记录以来，里卡多·罗塞略总督一直受到抨击……

sentences.en: And Puerto Ricans in general who have been seeing these bits and pieces come out are sort of just waiting for the next one to drop.
sentences.zh: 周六早上，波多黎各调查中心发布了889页的内容，详细记录了这两个月完整的聊天内容。

sentences.en: And then it's not that there's another bit that drops.
sentences.zh: 总督与其他11人之间泄露的聊天室对话中充斥着亵渎、恐同和性别歧视的评论。

sentences.en: Governor Ricardo Rosselló has been under fire since nearly 900 pages of a private group chat were leaked and published this weekend by the Center for Investigative...
sentences.zh: 第二批信息里有什么？

sentences.en: It's 889 pages published on Saturday morning by Puerto Rico's Center for Investigative Reporting, detailing two months of this chat in full.
sentences.zh: 第二批信息中有更多的侮辱内容，他们不仅针对总督及其政府的批评者，还针对他们的盟友。

sentences.en: The leaked chat room conversations between the governor and 11 others are laced with profane, homophobic, and sexist comments.
sentences.zh: 例如，一个超重的年轻人，他曾与总督会面，聊天中有一张两人握手的照片，总督开玩笑说……

sentences.en: And what is in the second batch of messages?
sentences.zh: 不，我没有变瘦。

sentences.en: The second batch of messages has more insults where not only are they targeting critics of the governor and his administration, but also their allies.
sentences.zh: 这是视觉错觉。

sentences.en: For example, a young man who is overweight, who met with the governor, and there's a picture in the chat of the two shaking hands, and the governor making a crack about...
sentences.zh: 不，我没有变瘦。

sentences.en: No, no estoy más flaco.
sentences.zh: 这是一种视觉错觉。

sentences.en: Es la ilusión óptica.
sentences.zh: 然后说……

sentences.en: No, I'm not thinner.
sentences.zh: 他产生了一个非常强的引力场。

sentences.en: It's an optical illusion.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他产生了属于他自己的引力场。

sentences.en: And then saying...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些事情简直是……

sentences.en: Genera un campo de gravedad muy fuerte.
sentences.zh: 残忍。

sentences.en: You know, he generates his own gravity field.
sentences.zh: ……不恰当。

sentences.en: I mean, things that are just really...
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Cruel.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，还有一个更大的背景，那就是在这个聊天室里的人已经不再是政府成员了，

sentences.en: ...inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 包括一名有自己商业利益的说客。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 他在总督知情的情况下，从他的哥们那里获得了内部消息。

sentences.en: But in addition to that, there is the bigger picture, which is that there are people in this chat who are no longer members of the government,
sentences.zh: 所以，在特朗普总统称波多黎各政府腐败几周后，所有这些起诉书基本上都证明他是对的。

sentences.en: including a lobbyist who has his own business interests.
sentences.zh: 然后就是这些泄密事件，将波多黎各政府描绘成对普通波多黎各人完全冷漠的形象。

sentences.en: And he is getting fed sort of inside information from his buddies with the governor being aware of it.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So weeks after President Trump calls the government of Puerto Rico corrupt, there are all these indictments that basically say he's right.
sentences.zh: 如果你愤世嫉俗地认为这些人更关心自己的形象而不是所作所为，如果你认为他们可能并不真正尊重人民，

sentences.en: And then there are these leaks that cast the Puerto Rican government as completely insensitive to everyday Puerto Ricans.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为他们可能并不真正尊重人民，

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为他们可能并不真正尊重人民，

sentences.en: If you thought cynically that these people were more concerned about how they look than what they do, if you thought that maybe they didn't really respect people,
sentences.zh: 如果你认为他们可能并不真正尊重人民，

sentences.en: even if they pretended outwardly that they did,
sentences.zh: 即使他们表面上假装他们做到了，

sentences.en: and if you were concerned that there was, if not real corruption, then the perception of corruption, that it could be happening, that people were really cozy with their friends,
sentences.zh: 如果你担心即使不是真正的腐败，也存在腐败的观感，担心这种事可能正在发生，担心人们真的与他们的朋友关系过于亲密，

sentences.en: with lobbyists and business leaders in their inner circle,
sentences.zh: 与他们核心圈子里的说客和商业领袖关系密切，

sentences.en: And so people started taking to the streets spontaneously, and they're very fed up.
sentences.zh: 于是人们开始自发地走上街头，他们真的受够了。

sentences.en: And so that's when I get on a plane and come, because we're starting to wonder if this is going to force the governor to resign.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我坐飞机赶来的原因，因为我们开始怀疑这是否会迫使州长辞职。

sentences.en: Is this going to be a moment that changes things?
sentences.zh: 这会是一个改变现状的时刻吗？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《纽约时报》应用程序，即可免费畅读30天。

sentences.en: So, Patti, walk me through the last few days in San Juan.
sentences.zh: 那么，帕蒂，带我回顾一下圣胡安过去几天的经历。

sentences.en: The streets of Old San Juan are narrow and colonial.
sentences.zh: 老圣胡安的街道狭窄且具有殖民风格。

sentences.en: They're cobblestone streets lined with shops that are painted in colorful red and pink and green and purple.
sentences.zh: 它们是铺着鹅卵石的街道，两旁排列着漆成红色、粉色、绿色和紫色的商店。

sentences.en: And they have been deserted during the day and packed at night, not because people are going to bars or there's a bunch of tourists here, but because the protesters come down.
sentences.zh: 白天这些街道空无一人，晚上却挤满了人，不是因为人们去酒吧或这里有很多游客，而是因为抗议者来了。

sentences.en: They come with flags in hand, and they're wearing black and white t-shirts with political messages.
sentences.zh: 他们手持旗帜，穿着印有政治标语的黑白T恤。

sentences.en: And they are just standing for hours, sometimes starting in the middle of the day under the scorching sun, in front, or as close as they can get in front,
sentences.zh: 他们就这样站了几个小时，有时从中午开始，顶着烈日，站在州长官邸前，或者尽可能靠近那里，

sentences.en: to the governor's mansion.
sentences.zh: 州长官邸。

sentences.en: La fortaleza, which means the fortress.
sentences.zh: “La Fortaleza”，意思是堡垒。

sentences.en: And they start chanting.
sentences.zh: 他们开始高呼口号。

sentences.en: And, you know, this is the Caribbean, so the percussion is great.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这是加勒比地区，所以打击乐非常棒。

sentences.en: They find these great rhymes with the governor's nickname, Ricky.
sentences.zh: 他们想出了很多与州长绰号“瑞奇”（Ricky）押韵的好词。

sentences.en: And so they just keep saying, Ricky, renuncia, you know, resign, resign.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一直喊着：“瑞奇，辞职”（Ricky, renuncia），你知道，辞职，辞职。

sentences.en: People were not just mad about these chats.
sentences.zh: 人们愤怒的不仅仅是这些聊天记录。

sentences.en: I mean, some of the signs were about that, some of the chants were about that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有些标语是关于这个的，有些口号也是关于这个的。

sentences.en: But one of the things that was really stunning was the number of protest signs that just listed the number of people who have been estimated could have died under Hurricane Maria.
sentences.zh: 但真正令人震惊的事情之一是，抗议标语中列出的数字，即据估计在玛丽亚飓风中可能丧生的人数。

sentences.en: So some signs just said 4,645, which is sort of the upper end estimate.
sentences.zh: 所以有些标语直接写着4645，这算是较高估算的数字。

sentences.en: These people have suffered not only through hurricanes and a power outage that lasted, you know, a year,
sentences.zh: 这些人不仅经历了飓风和持续了一年的停电，你知道，

sentences.en: but also with major economic hardships and layoffs and school closures and people leaving the island en masse to move to the mainland.
sentences.zh: 还经历了重大的经济困难、裁员、学校关闭，以及人们大规模离开岛屿前往美国本土。

sentences.en: And it all just was pent up, and it exploded all at once.
sentences.zh: 这一切都积压在心里，然后一下子爆发了。

sentences.en: And then, you know, the celebrities joined the people.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，名人们也加入了民众的行列。

sentences.en: And on Wednesday night, there is Ricky Martin and the rapper Residente and the trap musician Bad Bunny and the singer Ile.
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，瑞奇·马丁（Ricky Martin）、说唱歌手Residente、陷阱音乐人Bad Bunny和歌手Ile都来了。

sentences.en: And they're standing on the platform of this truck as the sun is setting and they're in front of the ocean, the Capitol behind them.
sentences.zh: 他们站在卡车平台上，夕阳西下，他们面对着大海，背后是国会大厦。

sentences.en: And Ile looks out over this crowd between the Capitol and the palm trees and the ocean, and she says it was about damn time to wake up.
sentences.zh: Ile看着国会大厦、棕榈树和大海之间的人群，她说，是时候该醒醒了。

sentences.en: So it's clear that a lot of this frustration is landing at the doorstep of the governor.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这种挫败感很大程度上指向了州长。

sentences.en: But my sense is that because of the complicated relationship between Puerto Rico and the United States, that the governor is not all that powerful, right?
sentences.zh: 但我的感觉是，由于波多黎各和美国之间复杂的关系，州长并没有那么大的权力，对吧？

sentences.en: It's interesting that you mention that, Michael, because one of the other chants that we heard was Ricky, renuncia y llévate a la junta.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你提到这一点很有趣，因为我们听到的另一个口号是“瑞奇，辞职并带上委员会一起走”（Ricky, renuncia y llévate a la junta）。

sentences.en: Como escuchan, los manifestantes gritan, Ricky, renuncia y llévate a la junta, haciendo referencia al gobernador y a la junta de supervisión fiscal.
sentences.zh: 正如你们听到的，抗议者高喊：“瑞奇，辞职并带上委员会一起走”，指的是州长和财政监督委员会。

sentences.en: Ricky, resign and take the board with you.
sentences.zh: 瑞奇，辞职并带上委员会一起走。

sentences.en: And that refers to this federal oversight board that Congress created to handle Puerto Rico's finances after it essentially went bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 这指的是国会在波多黎各实质上破产后，为处理其财务而设立的联邦监督委员会。

sentences.en: And that is another big target of these protests because the board's role is to tell Puerto Rico what it cannot spend.
sentences.zh: 这也是这些抗议活动的另一个主要目标，因为委员会的作用是告诉波多黎各什么不能花。

sentences.en: And that involves layoffs and school closures and university tuition hikes and possibly targeting public pensions.
sentences.zh: 这涉及裁员、学校关闭、大学学费上涨，以及可能针对公共养老金。

sentences.en: And so the board, which is unelected and comes from Washington, has made Puerto Ricans feel powerless.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个未经选举且来自华盛顿的委员会，让波多黎各人感到无能为力。

sentences.en: To a lot of them, it's just another example of how they have been colonized, first by Spain and then by the United States.
sentences.zh: 对他们中的许多人来说，这只是他们如何被殖民的又一个例子，先是被西班牙，然后是被美国。

sentences.en: And it reminds them that they can elect their governor, they can elect some of their leaders, but they cannot elect the president.
sentences.zh: 这提醒他们，他们可以选举自己的州长，可以选举一些领导人，但他们不能选举总统。

sentences.en: They are not a state, they are not a country, and a lot of this is out of their hands.
sentences.zh: 他们不是一个州，也不是一个国家，很多事情都超出了他们的掌控。

sentences.en: So the mismanagement by Puerto Rico's own leadership leads the federal government, a government that Puerto Ricans don't think really sees them as equal to the mainland,
sentences.zh: 因此，波多黎各自身领导层的管理不善，导致联邦政府——一个波多黎各人认为并没有真正把他们视为与美国本土平等地位的政府——

sentences.en: to step in.
sentences.zh: 介入其中。

sentences.en: And it's sort of this vicious cycle where the worse Puerto Rico's leadership behaves,
sentences.zh: 这是一种恶性循环，波多黎各的领导层表现得越糟糕，

sentences.en: the more the federal government intervenes and also is sort of proven correct in this argument that Puerto Rico doesn't deserve or can't quite properly handle this federal funding.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府干预得就越多，同时也似乎证明了那种认为波多黎各不值得或无法妥善处理这些联邦资金的论点是正确的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in the middle, the people of Puerto Rico keep suffering.
sentences.zh: 而在中间，波多黎各人民一直在受苦。

sentences.en: Patty, what happens now?
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，现在会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, the people on the streets want the governor to resign, but he says that he's not going to go.
sentences.zh: 嗯，街上的人们希望州长辞职，但他表示他不会走。

sentences.en: There's talk in the legislature that they might impeach him, but they have not decided if they're going to yet.
sentences.zh: 立法机构里有传言说他们可能会弹劾他，但他们还没有决定是否要这样做。

sentences.en: But even if he goes, then there's a whole new set of questions.
sentences.zh: 但即使他走了，又会产生一系列新的问题。

sentences.en: Can his replacement in that case govern?
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他的继任者能治理好吗？

sentences.en: Many Puerto Ricans would like more autonomy to govern themselves, but who can they trust when the federal government is not inclined to give them more autonomy?
sentences.zh: 许多波多黎各人希望有更多的自治权来管理自己，但在联邦政府不愿给予他们更多自治权的情况下，他们能信任谁呢？

sentences.en: The island government has not proven to be all that effective.
sentences.zh: 岛上的政府并没有证明自己有多么有效。

sentences.en: How can the next person lead an island under these circumstances, under this sort of federal oversight, without any money, recovering from a hurricane?
sentences.zh: 在这些情况下，在这样的联邦监督下，在没有资金、从飓风中恢复的过程中，下一个人该如何领导这个岛屿？

sentences.en: And basically, the biggest question is, is this island governable?
sentences.zh: 基本上，最大的问题是，这个岛还能治理吗？

sentences.en: Is this place a place that can be effectively run?
sentences.zh: 这个地方是一个可以被有效管理的地方吗？

sentences.en: And I don't know the answer to that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道答案。

sentences.en: Patty, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周四，美国

sentences.en: Navy shot down an Iranian drone in the Strait of Hormuz, not far from where Iran shot down a U.S.
sentences.zh: 海军在霍尔木兹海峡击落了一架伊朗无人机，距离伊朗几周前击落美国

sentences.en: drone several weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 无人机的地方不远。

sentences.en: The Trump administration said that before it was struck, the unmanned Iranian drone had ignored multiple warnings that it was straying close to an American ship, the USS Boxer.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府表示，在被击落之前，这架伊朗无人机无视了多次警告，偏离航线靠近了一艘美国军舰——“拳师号”两栖攻击舰（USS Boxer）。

sentences.en: The attack is expected to inflame tensions between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 预计这次袭击将加剧两国之间的紧张局势。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: When your supporters last night were chanting, send her back, why didn't you stop them?
sentences.zh: 当昨晚你的支持者高喊“送她回去”时，你为什么没有阻止他们？

sentences.en: Why didn't you ask them to stop saying that?
sentences.zh: 你为什么没有要求他们停止那样说？

sentences.en: Well, number one, I think I did.
sentences.zh: 嗯，第一，我想我做了。

sentences.en: I started speaking very quickly.
sentences.zh: 我开始说得非常快。

sentences.en: President Trump on Thursday tried to distance himself from supporters who chanted, send her back, at a rally the night before,
sentences.zh: 周四，特朗普总统试图与前一天晚上在集会上高喊“送她回去”的支持者保持距离，

sentences.en: when he mentioned Congresswoman Ilhan Omar of Minnesota, a reference to his own tweet about Omar and three of her Democratic colleagues.
sentences.zh: 当时他提到了来自明尼苏达州的国会女议员伊尔汗·奥马尔（Ilhan Omar），这是对他自己关于奥马尔和她三位民主党同事的推文的引用。

sentences.en: I disagree with it, by the way, but it was quite a chant, and I felt a little bit badly about it.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我不同意这种做法，但这确实是一个响亮的口号，我对此感到有点难过。

sentences.en: But contrary to the president's claim that he tried to quickly end the chant, video shows he listened on for 13 seconds as the crowd repeatedly yelled it.
sentences.zh: 但与总统声称他试图迅速结束这一口号的说法相反，视频显示他听了13秒，人群反复高喊着这个口号。

sentences.en: On Thursday afternoon, a large crowd greeted Congresswoman Omar as she returned to Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 周四下午，一大群人迎接了回到明尼苏达州的奥马尔议员。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
